title: 8 Things a Godly Man Refuses to Half-Do
caption:
Nobody grades the email you reread twice, or the corner you didn't cut when no one was checking. That's the point.

The extra ten minutes on something small. The credit given away before anyone asks who did it. The complaint swallowed instead of spread. Small work done well is still worship (Colossians 3:23), whether it makes the resume or not.

A godly man isn't measured by the version of his work his boss sees. He's measured by the version he'd hand to God without flinching.

Save this and pick the one you've been half-doing.
